title: Void hud
description: This resource pack replaces the familiar interface with a dark, empty one, in the style of Minecraft.
body: This resource pack will transform the familiar interface into an attractive, dark, and empty one. The changes will affect the quick access bar, menus, inventory, and much more. The resource pack is designed in the style of the original game, complete with end-game flashes. Enjoy playing with this resource pack (:
